title: Blogger Blog Configuration Schema
description: Canonical JSON Schema for local Blogger blog configuration and unexposed admin settings (blogger.config.json).

adultContent.description: Indicates whether the blog contains adult or sensitive content (data:blog.adultContent).

analyticsMeasurementId.description: Google Analytics 4 or Universal Analytics measurement ID (e.g. 'G-XXXXXXXXXX' or 'UA-XXXXX-X').

isPrivate.description: Specifies if the blog has restricted reader access (data:blog.isPrivate and data:blog.isPrivateBlog).

postsPerPage.description: Number of posts displayed per page on index/homepage views (data:widgets.Blog1.numPosts).

commentLocation.description: Comment placement mode in the blog layout.

commentFormMessage.description: Custom prompt or message displayed above the comment form (data:widgets.Blog1.messages.blogComment).

postDateFormat.description: Date format for post and page headers/timestamps (Unicode ICU TR35 pattern or Blogger format preset).

commentDateFormat.description: Timestamp format for published comments (Unicode ICU TR35 pattern or Blogger format preset).

titleAndEnclosureLinks.description: Enables post title links (data:posts[].link) and syndication enclosure MIME links (data:feedLinks[]).

entries.description: Per-entry (post or static page) configuration indexed by entry ID.

widgets.description: Widget-specific settings indexed by widget instance ID (e.g. 'Blog1', 'Header1') or widget type.

searchDescription.description: Post or static page search description meta tag content (max 150 characters).

commentMode.description: Comment permission setting: 'ALLOWED' (allow all), 'RESTRICTED' (show existing, disable new), 'DISABLED' (hide all).
